en.title: FCC Extends Accessibility Rules to Live Chat; Major Transit Funding Announced
en.summary: The Federal Communications Commission has clarified that its accessibility regulations now apply to live chat and messaging services, requiring providers to ensure usability for people with disabilities. Meanwhile, the Greater Cleveland Regional Transit Authority received a $20 million grant to upgrade rail accessibility, and Taiwan announced increased monthly subsidies for severely disabled persons.

zh-TW.title: FCC 認定即時聊天適用無障礙規則；台鐵獲2000萬升級經費
zh-TW.summary: 美國聯邦通訊委員會澄清，其無障礙法規現在適用於即時聊天與訊息服務，要求業者確保殘障人士可使用。同時，大克利夫蘭區域交通管理局獲得2000萬美元補助金，用於鐵路無障礙升級；台灣宣布提高中重度失能者每月最高補助至1萬5000元。
